notes: Hard (total 19). The single deliverable /app/solve.py must run on any scenario directory and emit seven interdependent artifacts. dependent_stages=3: a consolidated catalog is built by (i) a client-side COPY bulk-load, (ii) a direct byte-level B-tree salvage of a truncated SQLite file, and (iii) an auto WAL replay, then all three merge in id order before derived queries run. debugging_ambiguity=3 / adversarial_inputs=3: the truncated file can have its data page partially removed (or entirely absent) and the WAL is only recoverable by replaying the journal from a writable copy; the SQLite record layout (serial types 7 vs 6, leading NULL slot behind an INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, interior vs leaf pages) is easy to mis-handle. hidden_case_generalization=3: three distinct hidden scenarios probe a large salvage, a slash-1 page (empty salvage), domain/HAVING filtering, and dialect rewrites. quantitative_correctness=3: every recovered/salvaged/summary/fixed row set is compared exactly (floats rounded to 6). The one EASY competency (create-table with a prescribed schema) is not a drop from any floor: the task floor is hard (bundle includes an aggregate-HAVING competency whose floor is hard), so difficulty.hard is the correct bucket.
